title: Enchantment Lore + Enchantment Encore Extra
description: This adds world-building for all the enchantments across Vanilla and Enchantments Encore via book lore. Get to reading, worms!
body:
This brings a more RPG flair to enchantment lore, bringing in Elements, Guilds, Orders, etc.

You will need to install [Enchantment Lore](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-lore) and [Enchantment Encore](https://modrinth.com/datapack/enchantments-encore) for this to work, although this should work without Enchantment Encore. (Haven't tested)

Each book lists the enchantment's name, max level, application, and its RPG "origin" which obviously doesn't fit within Minecraft, but thus is worldbuilding. 

This is nice if you don't want to use any Enchantment description mods and want something a bit more immersive.

I've based these stories off of a worldbuilding setting. There are many repeated settings and guilds, gather them all up and you'll be able to read the world I wrote entirely. Good luck getting them all!
